story.x: Most NAS Are Made to Be Hidden. DA400 Is Made to Be Seen.For years, NAS devices have been built to do one thing well: store your data. But as our digital lives grow, simply storing files is no longer enough.

story.x: Meet StationPC DA400 AI NAS — a next-generation private AI cloud designed to live on your desk, not disappear into a closet.
story.z: 了解StationPC DA400 AI NAS —下一代私有AI云，专为您的办公桌而设计，不会消失在衣柜中。

story.x: With its distinctive transparent design and built-in 2.66" display, DA400 looks different from the very first glance. And underneath that design is something even more different: a dual-chip AI architecture built to let everyday AI and local 8B LLM workloads work side by side.One NAS. Two AI engines. Built to keep up with you.
story.z: 凭借其独特的透明设计和内置的2.66英寸显示屏， DA400看起来与第一眼不同。在这种设计之下，还有更不同的东西：双芯片人工智能架构，旨在让日常人工智能和本地8B LLM工作负载并肩工作。一个NAS。两个人工智能引擎。专为跟上您的步伐而打造。

story.x: Imagine uploading hundreds of photos while asking your NAS to summarize a document. On a single-chip system, AI workloads can compete for the same resources.
story.z: 想象一下，上传数百张照片，同时要求NAS总结文档。在单芯片系统上，人工智能工作负载可以竞争相同的资源。

story.x: StationPC DA400 AI NAS uses two AI engines working side by side: one handles everyday tasks like face recognition and semantic search, while the other runs local LLMs for conversations, summaries, and knowledge tasks.
story.z: StationPC DA400 AI NAS使用两个AI引擎并排工作：一个处理人脸识别和语义搜索等日常任务，另一个运行本地LLM以进行对话、摘要和知识任务。

story.x: Chat with AI on your StationPC DA400 AI NAS to pull up your pet photos, locate target files, summarize documents, translate content and answer questions. Everything runs locally on your NAS to keep your data fully private.
story.z: 在StationPC DA400 AI NAS上与人工智能聊天，提取您的宠物照片、查找目标文件、总结文档、翻译内容和回答问题。一切都在您的NAS上本地运行，以保持您的数据完全私密。

story.x: Find documents, contracts, project files, and creative assets using keywords or natural language on your StationPC DA400 AI NAS — no file names or folders required.

story.x: Let StationPC DA400 AI NAS analyze your files directly on-device and generate instant summaries. Get the key information faster—without sending your data to the cloud.

story.x: Automatically recognize and categorize people, pets, travel moments, and everyday scenes, making your memories easier to organize, browse, and find.
story.z: 自动识别和分类人员、宠物、旅行时刻和日常场景，让您更轻松地整理、浏览和查找美好回忆。

story.x: Automatically recognize text in screenshots, receipts, contracts, and meeting photos, then find them instantly with keywords.
story.z: 自动识别屏幕截图、收据、合同和会议照片中的文本，然后使用关键词即时查找。

story.x: With four drive bays and high-speed SSD caching, StationPC DA400 AI NAS gives you the capacity and performance to store your photos, videos, projects, and backups—all in one place.
story.z: 借助四个驱动器托架和高速SSD缓存， StationPC DA400 AI NAS为您提供了将照片、视频、项目和备份存储在一个地方的容量和性能。

story.x: HDDs & SDDs are not included

story.x: Insert your SD card and StationPC DA400 AI NAS automatically backs up your files—no app required. Clear your card after backup and get ready for your next capture.

story.x: Keep your data up to date across PCs, mobile devices, cloud storage, and NAS with automatic backup and sync. Your latest files are always right where you need them.
story.z: 借助自动备份和同步功能，跨PC、移动设备、云存储和NAS保持数据最新。您的最新文件始终在您需要的地方。

story.x: DA400 comes with essential apps pre-installed and ready to use. One-click installation makes it easy to add popular third-party apps, with 100+ apps available today and more on the way.
story.z: DA400附带预装的基本应用程序，可随时使用。一键安装即可轻松添加热门的第三方应用程序，目前已有100多个应用程序可用，而且即将推出更多应用程序。

story.x: Deploy containers and custom applications to extend DA400’s capabilities and build a NAS that fits your workflow.
story.z: 部署容器和自定义应用程序以扩展DA400的功能，并构建适合您工作流程的NAS。

story.x: A flexible, high-performance storage management system built for reliability, scalability, and easy access. StationOS Pro makes it easy to manage drives, storage pools, and RAID configurations for a more secure and efficient storage experience.
story.z: 灵活、高性能的存储管理系统，专为可靠性、可扩展性和易于访问而打造。StationOS Pro可轻松管理驱动器、存储池和RAID配置，以获得更安全、更高效的存储体验。

story.x: DA400 is built for advanced users who want to run local LLMs and manage massive media files with AI. Delivering powerful performance, expandable up to 136TB storage with no subscription fees. It supports LLMs with up to 8B parameters, compatible with Gemma, Qwen and other mainstream model series, along with AI image search, knowledge-base Q&A. If you plan to deploy large AI models locally while storing huge libraries of photos, videos and documents, DA400 can reliably run AI workloads, so you no longer spend hours manually searching through files.

story.x: DA400 Air is friendly for daily home storage and lightweight AI features. Expandable up to 136TB storage, with no subscription fees. It comes with AI image search, AI photo categorization, keyword image search. Ideal for backing up family photos, home videos and office documents. Not designed to run large local LLMs. If local LLM deployment is a priority, choose DA400.

story.x: Choose the storage configuration that fits your needs and expand it as your data grows.With DA400,you can build your own intelligent private cloud and keep full control of your data.
story.z: 选择适合您需求的存储配置，并随着数据的增长进行扩展。借助DA400 ，您可以构建自己的智能私有云，并完全控制您的数据。
